$description: 樂齡學習平台 Design System — derived from W3C WAI 'Developing Websites for Older People'. Import via Figma plugin 'Tokens Studio for Figma' (Import > single file). All decisions trace to a WCAG 2.0/2.1 success criterion noted in $description.

primary.$description: Body text on surface. Contrast 16.1:1 — exceeds WCAG 1.4.6 AAA (7:1).

secondary.$description: Supporting text. Contrast 9.7:1 on surface — passes 1.4.6 AAA.

muted.$description: Lowest-priority text. Contrast 7.0:1 — minimum allowed; never go lighter. 1.4.6 AAA.

onAccent.$description: Text on accent fill. Contrast 5.9:1 on accent.default — passes 1.4.3 AA.

link.$description: Link text. Contrast 5.9:1 on surface. 1.4.1 — never rely on colour alone; pair with underline.

page.$description: Light pastel page background, not pure white — W3C technique to avoid extreme contrast/glare for ageing eyes.

border.$description: Decorative borders. Contrast 3.1:1 — meets 1.4.11 non-text AA.

default.$description: Primary action blue. Calmer than neon; 5.9:1 with white text. 1.4.3 AA.

error.$description: Error text/border. 6.4:1 on surface. 3.3.1 error identification — always paired with icon + text, not colour alone (1.4.1).

ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring. Highly visible, 3px solid + 2px offset — W3C G195 / 2.4.7 Focus Visible AA.

base.$description: Body + UI. Clear, even-weight sans with full Traditional Chinese coverage. W3C: use readable fonts, upper/lower case.

display.$description: Headings use the same family at heavier weight — W3C: avoid overuse of different styles per page.

medium.$description: W3C prefers bolding over italics for emphasis.

fontSize.$description: Base 18px (not the web default 16px) so ageing eyes get larger default text — W3C 'provide large fonts by default'. All values in rem so users can resize to 200% without breakage (1.4.4 Resize Text AA). Scale ratio 1.2 (minor third).

caption.$description: 16px @18 base. Tags, meta. Floor — never smaller.

body.$description: Body — W3C 1.4.8 requires >=1.5 line spacing for older readers.

normal.$description: No negative tracking — keeps CJK + Latin legible.

text.$description: Max line length ~50–65 chars — W3C 1.4.8 limits line length to reduce reading effort.

spacing.$description: 8px base grid. Generous whitespace — W3C: allow for white space, group related items.

touchTarget.$description: Minimum interactive height/width. Exceeds WCAG 2.5.5 Target Size AAA (44px) for declining dexterity — W3C mouse-use guidance.

touchGap.$description: Minimum gap between adjacent targets to prevent mis-taps.

iconLg.$description: Tab-bar / primary nav icons — large + always paired with text label.

strong.$description: Selected/active control outline — visual cue beyond colour (1.4.1).
